hypothesis: M203 gives repeat-stable stage4 evidence from the M201 parent while M202 remains the best fixed-loss retained stage4 checkpoint. A single short guarded stage5 from M202 can be tested, but the elevated smoke eval in one M203 repeat requires keeping this to one short continuation.
success_criteria: start from runs/ppo_m202_stage4_from_m201_seed5206/checkpoint.pt because it is the lowest fixed-loss retained stage4 checkpoint
run only one short guarded stage5 before any repeat or longer continuation
keep M194 as the strong action anchor
preserve old M183 M168/M170 replay gates and refreshed M193 M189 replay gate
compare fixed M193 objective against M202 and M203 before accepting any repeat
failure_criteria: run multiple stage5 seeds before the first stage5 gate passes
run a longer PPO continuation directly
drop any M183 or M193 replay row
promote based on fixed objective improvement alone
